resources.string: Parents ask to link a child after verifying an OTP sent to the phone on the school record. Approve only when you are sure the request is genuine.

Creates their parent sign-in with a temporary password, shown once. They then see their children\'s attendance, homework, results and fees.
Their old password stops working and they are signed out everywhere. The new temporary password is shown once.
One slip per student for the primary guardian: username, temporary password, sign-in address and a QR code. You review the changes first.
Preparing login slips… this can take a minute.
Login slips are ready. Only you can open this PDF; hand each slip over privately.
